name: Sleeper API
summary: Sleeper's read-only API gives fantasy football data, like leagues, rosters, matchups and players, with no key needed.

free_plan_covers.note: Free with no plan or user cap. Sleeper asks you to stay under 1,000 calls a minute or risk your address being blocked, which is plenty if your server caches.

first_paid_usd_month.note: There is no paid plan. The API is free for non-commercial use; a commercial app has to arrange a license with Sleeper directly.

portability.note: The data comes in Sleeper's own shapes and ids, so moving to another fantasy platform or data service means rewriting the code that reads it.

official_api.note: Sleeper documents the API itself at docs.sleeper.com, with the base address https://api.sleeper.app/v1.

needs_api_key.note: No token is needed because the API is read-only: it can't change anything in Sleeper.

setup.step: No account or key: call https://api.sleeper.app/v1 from your server, starting with a user's leagues or a league's rosters.

builder_notes: Fetch the full players list (about 5 MB) at most once a day and store it on your server, as Sleeper asks.
Call Sleeper from server code and cache responses so the app stays well under 1,000 calls a minute.
The API is free only for non-commercial use; flag it before the app charges money.
